title: PlantDoctor
tagline: Photograph a sad plant, learn what's wrong.
description: Upload a photo of a houseplant showing symptoms and get a likely diagnosis plus a care checklist to nurse it back.
visualDirection: Clean botanical aesthetic with generous whitespace, using Inter for UI paired with subtle leaf illustrations as decorative elements. Muted sage backgrounds contrast with deep forest-green accents and warm terracotta highlights for actionable buttons.
scopeNotes: One AI vision call per diagnosis, informational not guaranteed accurate.
